Math & Statistics, University of Toronto

I'm a third-year student in the Mathematics Specialist, Statistics Stream. I'm drawn to probability theory, time series analysis, regression, and differential equations, and I'm currently diving into quantitative finance.

This website is a place for me to track my learning, document what I'm studying, and keep a record of the ideas and projects that shape my academic journey.

Outside of all the math, I do Judo and Muay Thai, watch movies, and thinking about my next outfit.

Right now I'm doing undergraduate research under Dr. Furlong

If anything here interests you, or you just want to talk, reach out. I love meeting new people.

Projects

Mostly quantitative finance, where I've been spending most of my time lately.

QuantiFi 2026 Trading Competition (UTEFA)Oct 2026

Co-developed a trading algorithm across 26 products using eleven strategies, each kept only if it held up on every training day, earning roughly 334K simulated PnL, positive on all three days. Priced call-option vouchers off a fitted volatility smile (Black–Scholes) with a delta hedge, accounting for 52% of total PnL, validated on a rebuilt backtester calibrated to official results.

Adaptive Reasoning ProxyMay – Aug 2026

Applied quantitative and statistical analysis to a live data stream, using SQLite to persist incoming requests and Redis to store and serve adaptive thresholds, reducing output volume by roughly 47% while keeping accuracy loss under 2%.

Osteoarthritis Severity ClassifierMay – Aug 2026

Developed and trained a convolutional neural network using ResNet-50 transfer learning in PyTorch with CUDA, improving the F1 score by 11% over a baseline through systematic hyperparameter tuning.

GridSight
